name: Victor’s Glory
body:
After winning a battle, you are more charismatic in the eyes of those who witnessed your victory.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, 1st-level duelist

Benefit: Whenever you win a battle, you gain a +1 bonus to all Charisma-based skill checks made against anyone who witnessed any part of the battle for 1 day per level of duelist you possess. This bonus increases to +2 when you have attained 4th level of the duelist class, +3 at 7th level, and +4 at 10th level. The bonus is doubled and lasts twice as long as normal if you fought the battle alone, without allies.
